gaps.criterion: A firm owner can invite a reviewer with a specific role by email
gaps.gap: Sending the invite is a Gherkin scenario; accepting it on /invite/:token needs the emailed token, which a UI run cannot read (MAIL_TRANSPORT=log). Accept is covered by tests/api_definitions/invites/token-accept-post.json and was verified in the browser ad hoc.

gaps.criterion: A user can log in, log out and reset a forgotten password
gaps.gap: Sign-in, sign-out and requesting a reset link are Gherkin scenarios; the /reset-password?token= page needs the emailed token, so choosing the new password is not in a committed UI run.
